narr: A strong area of low pressure tracked to the west of the area across Western New York on the night of November 30th before stalling by the morning of December first. A warm and moist Atlantic moisture fetch allowed for an anomalous southeasterly airmass for the beginning of December to move into the region. Heavy rain occurred across the region with widespread reports of 2 to 3 of rain being reported across the eastern slopes of the Western Maine Mountains. This led to localized flooding and minor damage.
ev: Heavy rain with measured amounts of 2.82 being reported in the vicinity of Newry, ME lead to localized flash flooding at the Sunday River Ski Resort. In addition to the heavy rain, melting man made snow contributed to rapid runoff. Heavy erosion and undermining caused damage to one of the base areas at Sunday River Resort.
